basis: Strict meaning: visible requires visible ongoing/imminent serious harm to a person or an actively occurring critical failure; hazard presence or damage alone is insufficient.

cases.reason: Downed utility pole and wires are visible, but no immediate serious harm to a person or active critical failure is shown; whether wires are live is unknown.
A threatening message is visible, but an ongoing/imminent attack is not established by the image.
Aerial flooding alone does not show immediate serious harm to a person.
Building damage alone does not show immediate serious harm to a person.
A person is wading in floodwater, but the image does not establish immediate serious harm.
Debris damage alone does not show immediate serious harm to a person.

Flooded structures alone do not show immediate serious harm to a person.

limitations: Original-image reinspection covered 11 cases: A05,A10,A11,A16,A25,A28,A32,A33,A38,A43,A46. A12 and A22 flags were corrected from the previously reviewed panels and visible descriptions; their original files were not reopened in this pass.
